outcome: The accepted UI/UX redesign is complete: one focused ribbon and one role-aware Experiment Control panel
owner_impact: The Control panel now has the final Professor-only Research curation section. Showcase browsing/publication and scientific Capability requests live there instead of in global navigation or temporary compatibility controls. Students keep the same shared Experiment management surface without Professor controls. The accepted ribbon remains Virtual Lab / Eliseo Ferrante · Swarm robotics with Simulation, Authoring, Help and Account.

next.text: The current #273 UI/UX activation is complete. #273 remains open but dormant as a living UI/UX maintenance domain; there is no automatic next UI ticket. Use the live Lab normally and future UI work should come from concrete usage evidence.

technical_evidence: The temporary experiment-professor-compat bridge and its temporary wording are removed.
A Professor-only experiment-professor-section named Research curation is integrated inside the task-based Control panel.
The existing authoritative Showcase launcher, current-publication action and curation status are relocated into Research curation rather than reimplemented.
Capability requests opens the existing Professor request inbox and reflects its pending count without changing request semantics.
Showcase publication is removed from Current Experiment actions; the Experiments library entry remains there.
The global ribbon still excludes Experiment, Results, Showcase and Professor; Results remains within Simulation.
Signed-out responsive production smoke verifies that Professor controls do not leak to ordinary users and that no temporary compatibility section remains.
No scientific/runtime, authorization, revision/Working-copy/autosave, sharing, Showcase publication, capability-request or connector semantics are changed.

Responsive production smoke now waits for a fresh document after the mobile Page.reload before applying readiness assertions, eliminating the old-document/new-document race exposed by production #321.
